text:
tara: heads-up: starting staged rollout for ff:llm-cache-slim tonight 00:15 UTC. goal: reduce tokenization overhead so p95 drops ~20ms. rollout plan: micro-canary -> phased cohorts. steps: 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 60%. step_interval=9m, soak=4m. runtime pinned to v2.3.3 for the window.
lee: ack. which metrics are hard stop vs pause?
tara: hard stop: any OOMs or customer error-rate > 0.6% -> immediate rollback. pause if p95 regresses > 50ms for two consecutive soaks or QA_COVERAGE drops >1.2x.
omar: I'll enable transient debug, sample 300 outputs per cohort and run quick diff vs baseline. uploading samples to #model-audit.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: ff:llm-cache-slim -> micro-canary(1%), eng-internal(2%), partner-beta(10%), public-a(25%), public-b(60%). start=1707708888, step=9m, soak=4m, pinned=v2.3.3. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-513
support-bot: release-note tag created: rollout/cache-slim. Support notified to #support-watch.
lee: please paste a one-liner for triage.
tara: release note: "llm-cache-slim: streamlined token cache and tokener batching; staged rollout pinned to runtime v2.3.3. Watch p95 latency, OOMs, and QA_COVERAGE."
omar: yank commands if needed:
```
# global disable
/feature toggle ff:llm-cache-slim off --force
# shrink cohort
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-cache-slim public-b 0
# annotate drained samples
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-cache-slim partner-beta --tag drained-for-investigation
```
observability-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p95-llm-latency-cache-slim (threshold 50ms, eval 4m) -> notify #eng-oncall & #eng-releases. monitor/oom -> critical.
tara: decision tree: if first monitor fire -> pause rollout and collect traces for 20m; if second fire or OOMs -> rollback. keep runtime pinned until ML + eng signoff post verification.
lee: if we pause, retain debug sampling for at least 30m.
omar: starting micro-canary in 2m. @deploy-bot please post cohort events here.
deploy-bot: micro-canary enabled (1%) at 1707709000. rolllog: cohort->micro-canary, pinned=v2.3.3.
omar: sampling 300 -> p95 delta +8ms, QA_COVERAGE stable. no OOMs.
lee: looks fine so far, dashboards steady.
observability-bot: heartbeat: no alerts.
tara: moving to eng-internal in 7m if no guardrail hits. tag weird outputs with #cache-slim-anom.
omar: noted, will export flagged examples to the runbook.
support-bot: reminder: change window closes at 02:15 UTC. if we stop mid-rollout, create rollback ticket and ping CSMs for any impacted customers.
tara: thanks. short updates at each cohort change. :shipit:
